protocol.measurementFramework: Custom allocation/Stopwatch workload in the actual native InMemory.FunctionalTests fixture, not BenchmarkDotNet.
protocol.primaryMetric: GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(precise:true) delta for 128 completed 65536-byte operations on an already established actual sample stream
protocol.secondaryMetric: Stopwatch elapsed for exactly the same completed operations
protocol.payload: 65536 ASCII bytes with the fixed repeating printable pattern used by the accepted real-read producer
protocol.variantOrder: Alternate baseline/candidate order by observation index
protocol.F147Primary: Unidirectional real read, decode, console-string receipt and exact consumer comparison
protocol.F147UnchangedControl: Bidirectional real read, decode/ordinary command, reversal, awaited echo and exact byte comparison
protocol.F149Primary: Bidirectional real read, decode/ordinary command, reversal, awaited echo and exact byte comparison
protocol.F149UnchangedControl: Unidirectional real read, decode, console-string receipt and exact consumer comparison
protocol.caseOrderWithinProcess: Primary then control on even observations; control then primary on odd observations
protocol.absoluteSavingExplanation: At least 90 percent of the 8388608-byte payload copied by ToArray over 128 operations; excludes array headers from the minimum.

sourceAndRuntimeBoundary.sampleOwners: Each independently source-built Original or observed-default sample owner with its own source/reference/restore graph.
sourceAndRuntimeBoundary.commonProducer: One independently rebuilt Original37 InMemory.FunctionalTests fixture/Kestrel producer closure, compiled once and identical for all variants.
sourceAndRuntimeBoundary.defaultLabelMeans: Current-default sample owner under the frozen common Original Kestrel/runtime57 producer; NOT a whole current-default framework/runtime validation.

admission.unusedThirdAuthorization: Permanently close unused; not a retry or tuning entitlement.
admission.publication: Fork-only independent drafts; each genuinely new justified draft gets its own visible new Edge window.

intentionalExclusions: Native QUIC/MsQuic, TLS, physical network, browser, routing and full sample startup/certificate setup
Stateful UTF8 decoding or repairing existing split-sequence behavior
Changing public API, package/SDK manifests or machine settings
